question: Can all 80 C01-C08 topology parents deterministically support three area-preserving shape realizations, and is the planned 757,290-frame P1 export feasible with current rendering and provenance backends?
method: Read-only reconstruction of all edge primitives, SHA-256-derived ellipse/rounded-rectangle/C1-mixed parameters, exact area audit, existing Zarr size inventory and measured-throughput resource projection.
baseline: One archived constant-radius geometry realization per topology parent and the existing native CPU range renderer.
fallback: If topology/shape/disk contracts fail, stop P1. If only current Python provenance throughput fails, implement and benchmark an accelerated identity-preserving backend before any full export.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly 80 C01-C08 parents, 8,039 source edges, 240 realizations, 24,117 realized primitives, 757,290 planned frames and 564,378 planned five-frame sequences.
Every endpoint section preserves the archived circular area within 1e-10 m2 and all identities remain stable.
Projected compressed sensor data uses less than half currently available disk and measured native rendering projects to <=12 serial hours.
Current Python provenance throughput is explicitly classified unscalable when its measured projection exceeds seven serial days; P1 export then remains blocked pending acceleration.
expected_evidence: Per-world shape inventory, exact shape ranges and area error, historical-storage projection, native/provenance throughput projection, PNG/PDF/SVG resource figure, metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User requested continuous autonomous execution and optimal in-plan choices without repeated approval prompts.
user_authorization.scope: Exactly one immutable zero-training 80-parent metadata/resource inventory; no sensor value read, export, model, graph or M-TARE.
